name: Arugula-Tempeh Salad with Blistered Tomatoes, Avocado & Chive Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice tempeh. Place in a large bowl, drizzle with soy sauce, and stir to coat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add tempeh and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, 5-7 minutes. Transfer tempeh to a plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet and bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: While the tempeh is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ lemons
1 small pkg chives
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs baby arugula
3 avocados

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tomatoes and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to brown and burst, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool, 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice lemons into the reserved bowl.

Chop chives into small pieces. Add half to the bowl with the lemon juice along with mayo, oil, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing. (Reserve remaining chives for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup mayonnaise
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add arugula and cooled tomatoes to the bowl with the dressing. Gently toss to combine the salad.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and large dice. Season with salt.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with avocado, tempeh, and reserved chives. Enjoy!
